comment.body: Thanks for reporting that the 0.70.0 updater closed PowerToys without a message when C: had little free space. Related #38227 was a duplicate variant, but that does not establish the behavior is fixed. Could you confirm whether this still happens on a current version and approximately how much free space was available on C: and the install volume? This distinguishes a staging-space failure from an outdated report; no logs are needed.

proposed_fixes.title: Report insufficient update staging space before closing
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Updater may fail while staging installer files on a nearly full volume without surfacing a user-facing error; volume and threshold unknown.
plan: Reproduce low space on system and install volumes separately.
Check required staging space before shutting down PowerToys or starting setup.
Show required/available space and preserve recoverable state.
verification: Low-space failure displays clear message and leaves PowerToys restartable; update succeeds with adequate space.

confidence.rationale: Clear low-space symptom, but exact free space/current build/failing volume missing.
